requirements.title: ISO_FORTRAN_ENV provides public Fortran environment entities
requirements.source: S16.10.2.1 p1; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF472.
requirements.definition: The ISO_FORTRAN_ENV intrinsic module provides public entities relating to the Fortran environment.

pending.iso-fortran-env-public-environment-entit: Source-use inventory plan cross-references every 16.10.2 entity catalogue to ISO_FORTRAN_ENV; executable fixtures import individual standard names rather than proving the prose topic sentence.

requirements.oracle: Plans are pending and source-derived. Positive plans observe only portable single-image properties fixed by 16.10.2: named-constant type/kind/rank, exact relational properties among ISO_FORTRAN_ENV constants and intrinsic inquiries, successful use of preconnected units, or exact IOSTAT named-constant assignment. Processor-dependent numeric values, module extensions, compiler option/version text, team identity, atomic/event behavior, multi-image preconnection, and message text are not asserted.
requirements.oracle_limitation: Source accounting only. This packet creates no Fortran fixture, compiler invocation, execution evidence, evidence link, fixture approval, oracle approval, or coverage claim. Fixture authors must re-derive every pending plan from the pinned source. Existing tests and profiles mention ISO_FORTRAN_ENV, CHARACTER_KINDS, INTEGER_KINDS, COMPILER_VERSION text in a test name, and unrelated INT8-style identifiers; this packet records that coverage without rebinding it.
requirements.dependencies: Registered dependencies: clauses 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, and 12 for source form, declarations, expressions, execution, program units, intrinsic assignment, and I/O harnesses. Unregistered dependencies explicitly retained: remaining 16.10.2 ISO_FORTRAN_ENV entities, 16.9 inquiry procedures such as BIT_SIZE, KIND, RANK, SIZE, LBOUND, and STORAGE_SIZE, clause 17 atomic/IEEE terms, clause 18 interoperability context, and clause 19 storage units and image/team terminology.

requirements.title: Processors provide the described ISO_FORTRAN_ENV entities
requirements.source: S16.10.2.1 p2 first sentence; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF472.
requirements.definition: The processor shall provide the named constants, derived types, and procedures described in 16.10.2.

pending.iso-fortran-env-named-constants-provided: Future source-use inventory imports the standard named constants from 16.10.2, including the batch211 constants ATOMIC_INT_KIND, ATOMIC_LOGICAL_KIND, CHARACTER_KINDS, CHARACTER_STORAGE_SIZE, CURRENT_TEAM, ERROR_UNIT, FILE_STORAGE_SIZE, INITIAL_TEAM, INPUT_UNIT, INT8, INT16, INT32, INT64, INTEGER_KINDS, IOSTAT_END, and IOSTAT_EOR.
pending.iso-fortran-env-derived-types-provided: Future source-use inventory imports the standard derived types from 16.10.2; EVENT_TYPE import is recorded in this packet with event/coarray fixtures out of scope.
pending.iso-fortran-env-procedures-provided: Future source-use inventory imports and calls the standard procedures from 16.10.2; batch211 covers COMPILER_OPTIONS and COMPILER_VERSION result characteristics without checking processor-dependent content.

review_rationale: Source registration for 16.10, 16.10.1, 16.10.2 and 16.10.2.1-16.10.2.17 of the intrinsic module ISO_FORTRAN_ENV (batch211). Every unit hash-verified by an independent reviewer with zero findings (16.10.2.7 extraction drift verified visually on pages 472-473); C1603-C1606 were pre-accounted numbered rules with no existing test coverage; atomic, event and team facets are out of scope. Source accounting only.
